analysis: Local offline over-representation, optional local preranked GSEA, and ortholog-mapped pathway network comparison

GO.version: GO basic ontology snapshot plus gene associations dated 2026-05-21
GO.organism_policy: Separate taxon-filtered human and mouse GAF annotations; ancestor propagation uses is_a and part_of.

Reactome.organism_policy: Human R-HSA pathways only; no mouse Reactome terms are reported.

WikiPathways.organism_policy: Separate Homo sapiens and Mus musculus collections; Entrez IDs map locally to Ensembl.

Ensembl.version: Local whole-gene ID maps; BioMart release is not encoded in the downloaded tables.
Ensembl.organism_policy: Unique Entrez and symbol mappings only for source identifiers; Ensembl stable IDs remain species-specific.

identifier_policy: No gene identifiers are uploaded. Gene sets and ID conversions are computed from local snapshots. Ambiguous source-symbol/Entrez mappings are excluded rather than guessed.

statistics.ora: Hypergeometric upper-tail test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction over all tested pathways within species, gene set, and database; genes outside the annotated library are excluded from that database's universe.
statistics.gsea: Local gseapy prerank against in-memory local gene sets; 1000 permutations and seed 42 when enabled.

comparison.module_preservation: Maximum Jaccard similarity of ortholog-mapped within-pathway module membership.
comparison.network_edge_drift: 1 - conserved mapped within-pathway edges / union of conserved, lost, and gained mapped edges; undefined for empty unions.
comparison.key_pathway_rule: At least one species has pathway ORA FDR <= 0.05 and the measurable within-pathway mapped edge divergence is greater than zero.
